resources.string: Something went wrong? Choose what to include and tell me what happened. You can review everything before sharing.
There are no text passages yet. Choose the whole lecture or a time range.
Enter the start and end as minutes:seconds or hours:minutes:seconds.
Enter a valid start and a later end, up to 24 hours.
For wrong or missing words, include audio and text so I can compare them. A time range shares only that audio; a whole lecture may create a large file.
For example: it repeated the first words and missed the next sentence.
Write the words you actually said, if you know them.

The report includes this lecture’s status, your notes, app/device details, settings, and available timing/error records. Audio and transcript text are included only if selected. It stays on your tablet until you choose to share or save it.
Stop recording or pause this lecture’s transcription first, then try again.
The report exceeds 256 MB. Choose a shorter time range or leave out the audio.
The report could not be prepared. Check available storage and audio access. For an unreadable excerpt, try the whole lecture or leave out audio.

Also included: this lecture’s status, app version, model/language settings, device model, Android version, and available timing/error records. Older lectures may have no measurements. The report contains no other lectures or device-wide logs.
Text passages overlapping your selection are included in full, with original recognition text where available and any saved corrections.
Some or all selected audio is unavailable and could not be attached. The report lists the missing sections. Deleted recordings cannot be recovered.
Tap Share report, choose WhatsApp, and choose our chat. Nothing is sent automatically. The prepared copy is temporary; save a copy if you want to keep it.
The copy could not be saved. The prepared report is still available for sharing.
Sharing could not be opened. Try Save a copy instead.

Open a lecture and tap Report a problem. Choose what went wrong and the whole lecture, a passage, or a time range. Audio and text are optional: select them for transcription problems. Add a note or the correct words if you like. Prepare report shows what is included and its size. Tap Share report, choose WhatsApp, then our chat. Nothing is sent automatically. Save a copy keeps a ZIP file where you choose. Stop recording or pause transcription before preparing a report. Deleted audio cannot be attached; older lectures may have no timing records.
